auth.sign_in.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in page.

auth.sign_in.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Button that submits the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.passkey.description: Button on the sign-in page that signs in with a passkey (WebAuthn) instead of the email address and password. Shown only in browsers that support passkeys.

auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.defaultMessage: 未使用通行金鑰。請再試一次，或使用電子郵件地址與密碼登入。
auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the browser's passkey prompt was dismissed or failed before anything was sent to the server.

auth.sign_in.forgot_password_link.description: Link from the sign-in form to the page that asks for a password reset link.

auth.sign_in.sign_up_link.description: Link from the sign-in page to the registration page; hidden while registration is closed.

auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: 此伺服器只能透過登入服務登入。若你的帳號沒有連結任何登入服務，請聯絡管理員。
auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.description: Note on the sign-in page, and the refusal of a sign-in with a password or a passkey, while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same for every account.

auth.external.heading.description: Heading above the buttons of the sign-in and registration pages that sign in with another service (an external login provider) that the server's administrators set up.

auth.external.heading_only.description: Heading above the buttons of the sign-in and registration pages while only those services sign in: there is no form above them, so it has no "or".

auth.external.sign_up.title.description: Title of the registration page for an account at an external login provider. {provider} is the provider's name as the administrators wrote it.

auth.external.sign_up.email_hint.defaultMessage: 你會在這個地址收到電子郵件。我們會寄送驗證連結。
auth.external.sign_up.email_hint.description: Hint under the email address on the registration page of an account at an external login provider, when the provider did not confirm the address.

auth.two_factor.title.description: Title and heading of the second step of signing in, which asks for an authentication code.

auth.two_factor.prompt.defaultMessage: 請輸入驗證器應用程式顯示的六位數驗證碼。若無法使用該應用程式，請改為輸入一組復原碼。
auth.two_factor.prompt.description: Text above the code field on the second step of signing in, for users who turned on two-factor authentication.

auth.two_factor.code_label.description: Label of the code field on the second step of signing in, which takes a six-digit code of an authenticator app or a recovery code.

auth.two_factor.submit.description: Button that submits the authentication code on the second step of signing in.

auth.two_factor.restart_link.description: Link from the second step of signing in back to the sign-in form, to start over.

auth.signed_in.title.description: Title and heading of the page shown when a signed-in user opens the sign-in page.

auth.signed_in.continue.description: Link on the signed-in page back to where the user was going.

auth.sign_out.submit.description: Button that ends the current browser session.

auth.error.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in screens' error pages.

auth.document.footer_label.description: Accessible name of the navigation in the footer of the sign-in, registration and consent screens that links to the terms of service and the privacy policy.

auth.document_title.description: The browser tab title of the sign-in, sign-up, email verification, account status and consent pages: the page's title, then the server's name. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

auth.status_page.link.description: Text of the link to the instance's status page (ADR-0088) in the footer of the sign-in, registration and consent screens, shown only when the operator set status_page_url.

auth.link.new_tab.description: Text that only assistive technology reads, after the name of a link on the sign-in and registration pages that opens in a new browser tab (the CAPTCHA service's privacy policy and terms, the server's terms on the registration form). Keep the brackets so that it reads apart from the link's name.

auth.sign_up.title.description: Title and heading of the registration page.

auth.sign_up.closed.defaultMessage: 此伺服器目前不接受新帳號。
auth.sign_up.closed.description: Body of the registration page while the server accepts no new accounts.

auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: 此伺服器只能透過登入服務註冊新使用者。
auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.description: Note on the registration page, and the refusal of a registration with a password, while the instance limits registration to login providers.

auth.sign_up.username_label.description: Label of the username field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_hint.defaultMessage: 你會使用這個地址登入。
auth.sign_up.email_hint.description: Hint under the email address field of the registration form.

auth.sign_up.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.invite_label.description: Label of the invite code field of the registration form, required while the server accepts sign-ups by invitation only and optional otherwise.

auth.sign_up.reason_label.description: Label of the free-text field asking why the applicant wants to join, shown when sign-ups need a moderator's approval.

auth.sign_up.agreement.defaultMessage: 建立帳號前，請先閱讀此伺服器的下列文件。
auth.sign_up.agreement.description: Notice above the links to the instance's terms of service and privacy policy (only those it has published) on the registration form, followed by the checkbox that agrees to them.

auth.sign_up.agreement.label.defaultMessage: 我已閱讀並同意上述文件
auth.sign_up.agreement.label.description: Label of the required checkbox under the links to the instance's terms of service and privacy policy on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.submit.description: Button that submits the registration form.

auth.verify_email.title.defaultMessage: 驗證你的電子郵件地址
auth.verify_email.title.description: Title and heading of the page that a confirmation email links to.

auth.verify_email.prompt.defaultMessage: 請選取下方按鈕以驗證你的電子郵件地址。
auth.verify_email.prompt.description: Text above the button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.submit.description: Button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.verify_email.done.defaultMessage: 謝謝。你的電子郵件地址已驗證。
auth.verify_email.done.description: Body of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.forgot_password.title.description: Title and heading of the page that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.prompt.defaultMessage: 請輸入你帳號的電子郵件地址。我們會寄送設定新密碼的連結到該地址。
auth.forgot_password.prompt.description: Text above the form that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.email_label.description: Label of the email address field of the form that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.submit.description: Button that asks for a password reset link by email.

auth.forgot_password.unavailable.defaultMessage: 此伺服器不寄送電子郵件，因此無法寄送連結給你。請向伺服器的管理員索取設定新密碼的連結。
auth.forgot_password.unavailable.description: Text of the page that asks for a password reset link on a server that sends no email; an administrator can issue the link.

auth.forgot_password.login_providers_onl.defaultMessage: 此伺服器只能透過登入服務登入，因此無法在此重設密碼。若你的帳號沒有連結任何登入服務，請聯絡管理員。
auth.forgot_password.login_providers_onl.description: Replaces the form that asks for a password reset link, and answers it, while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same for every address.

auth.reset_password.title.description: Title and heading of the page that a password reset link opens.

auth.reset_password.prompt.defaultMessage: 請選擇新密碼。設定後，你會在所有地方登出。你的通行金鑰與兩步驟驗證會維持不變。
auth.reset_password.prompt.description: Text above the form that sets a new password from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.password_label.description: Label of the new password field of the page that a password reset link opens.

auth.reset_password.submit.description: Button that sets the new password from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after a new password was set from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.done.defaultMessage: 你的密碼已變更，所有使用舊密碼的工作階段都已登出。請使用新密碼登入。
auth.reset_password.done.description: Body of the page after a new password was set from a reset link.

auth.authorize.title.description: Title and heading of the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the name of the application asking for access.

auth.authorize.lead.defaultMessage: {app} 想以下列權限使用你的帳號：
auth.authorize.lead.description: Introduces the list of permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the application's name.

auth.authorize.redirect_notice.defaultMessage: 你做出選擇後，會被送回 {host}。
auth.authorize.redirect_notice.description: Note under the permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {host} is the host name the application receives the answer at.

auth.authorize.approve.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that lets the application use the account.

auth.authorize.deny.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that refuses the application.

auth.status.title.defaultMessage: 你的帳號尚未準備就緒
auth.status.title.description: Title and heading of the page a signed-in user sees while their account cannot be used yet (waiting for approval or email confirmation, or rejected).

auth.status.restricted_title.description: Title and heading of the page a signed-in user sees while a moderation action keeps their account out of the app.

auth.status.deactivated_title.description: Title of the page that a user who deactivated their account sees after signing in.

auth.status.pending.defaultMessage: 你的註冊正在等待版主核准。你可以登入，但要等核准後才能使用應用程式。
auth.status.pending.description: Explains that a moderator has not yet approved the registration and that the app cannot be used until then.

auth.status.rejected.defaultMessage: 你的註冊未獲核准，因此無法使用此帳號。
auth.status.rejected.description: Tells a signed-in user that a moderator rejected their registration.

auth.status.resend_submit.description: Button that sends the email confirmation link again.

auth.status.restricted.defaultMessage: 版主已對你的帳號執行處置，因此你無法使用應用程式。以下處置正在生效：
auth.status.restricted.description: Explains to a signed-in user that moderation actions (login disabled, suspension) keep them out of the app; the list of the actions follows.

auth.status.action_active.description: Badge next to a moderation action on the user's account that is in effect, on the status page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. The account status page of the app says the same.

auth.status.appeal_label.description: Label of the field in which a user whose account is restricted writes their appeal of a moderation action (why a moderator should reconsider it).

auth.status.appeal_submit.description: Button that sends the user's appeal of a moderation action on their account. The account status page of the app says the same.

auth.status.appeal_answer.description: Label before the moderators' explanation of their decision on the user's appeal, on the status page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted.

auth.status.deactivated.defaultMessage: 你已停用此帳號，因此所有人都看不到它，也不會收到任何內容。
auth.status.deactivated.description: Explains to a signed-in user that they deactivated their account and what that means.

auth.status.deactivated_deletion.defaultMessage: 除非你重新啟用，否則帳號將在 {date} 刪除。
auth.status.deactivated_deletion.description: States when the deactivated account is deleted. {date} is the date and time with its time zone, such as 2026-12-03 09:00 (UTC).

auth.status.deactivated_reactivate_hint.defaultMessage: 你的貼文、追蹤與追蹤者都會維持原樣。停用期間傳送給你的內容不會送達，且應用程式需要重新授權。
auth.status.deactivated_reactivate_hint.description: Hint under the button that brings back a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_reactivate.description: Label of the button that brings back a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_delete_heading.description: Heading of the form that deletes a deactivated account at once.

auth.status.deactivated_delete_hint.defaultMessage: 此操作無法復原。你的貼文與帳號會消失，你的使用者名稱也將永遠無法再使用。
auth.status.deactivated_delete_hint.description: Hint of the form that deletes a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_password_label.description: Label of the field that confirms the deletion of a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_delete.description: Label of the button that deletes a deactivated account.

auth.status.deleted_title.description: Title of the page after a user deleted their deactivated account.

auth.status.deleted.defaultMessage: 你的帳號與貼文已刪除，其他伺服器也已收到通知。
auth.status.deleted.description: Message of the page after a user deleted their deactivated account.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.title.description: Title and heading of the page that the unsubscribe link of a notification email opens.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.submit.description: Button that stops the emails of an unsubscribe link.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after an unsubscribe link stopped its emails.
